takeaway: DeepSeek Harness has become a plugin ecosystem: DeepSeek's own agent repo more than doubled in a day to 9,748 stars, and the deepseek-harness topic holds 20,947 repos. The radar now measures most of its ranking through the GitHub API.

findings.heading: DeepSeek Harness: a 20,947-repo plugin ecosystem
findings.text: The deepseek-harness topic includes desktop clients (dsh-desktop, 34,452 stars), a plugin list (21,941), a phone client (dsh-Go) and a free-model plugin with 56,223 stars.

findings.heading: DeepSeek's agent repo more than doubles
findings.text: deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype went from 4,586 to 9,748 stars in a day, measured by the radar through the API.

findings.heading: Most of the ranking is now measured
findings.text: 924 apps were read on both of the last two days, and 44% of the evidence behind the top 25 is the radar's own API measurement, up from 20% yesterday.

findings.heading: Two weak forecasts in a row
findings.text: The Oct 25 and Oct 26 rankings got 40% and 33% of their top 15 right, against 73% on Oct 24. Both predate the API data, and the week after them was dominated by new launches.

findings.heading: Sierra reports $400M+ ARR
findings.text: The customer-service agent company says it doubled from $200M to $400M in five months and added over $150M in the third quarter alone. Read from search results.

caveats: The API-found ranking includes some off-topic fast growers (an Android TV debloater is #2); a way to mark apps out of scope is not built yet.
Forecasts scored so far were made before API measurement began; the scorecard tests the new setup from Nov 8.
All company figures today come from search-result summaries.
Hugging Face and Hacker News remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
